about: The ViewModel specification is drishti-rachana's spec/1/viewmodel.schema.json (decision N3: one contract, one home). drishti_viewmodel.schema.json beside this file is a byte-for-byte copy; sha256 is its hash. python3 tools/views/gen.py --sync DIR copies it again from a drishti-rachana checkout and rewrites this file; a static test refuses a copy whose hash differs from this pin, and, when a drishti-rachana checkout sits beside this project, a pin that differs from its file.
